h1: Wine flights and *cozy nights on Greens Prairie.*
lead: Global and local wines, curated flights, craft beer and cocktails, on the patio or inside. Rated 4.5 stars by 122 Google reviewers.
about: Melba Tucker owns Downtown Uncorked, an upscale but cozy wine bar on Greens Prairie Road. Visit College Station calls it a go-to for wine lovers and newcomers alike.
The list covers global and local wines, curated flights, craft beer and cocktails, with dessert to match. Melba also opens the space for private events.
